_comment: Copy to mcp.config.json (git-ignored) or point SIBYL_MCP_CONFIG at it. Each server is either stdio (command/args/env) or Streamable HTTP (url/headers). ${VAR} is replaced from the gateway's environment. Tools appear as mcp_<server>_<tool>; tools not marked readOnlyHint need your approval before they run. Keys starting with _ are comments; "disabled": true skips a server.

files._comment: Official filesystem server, limited to one folder. Change the last arg to the folder Sibyl may read and write.

remote._comment: Placeholder for a remote MCP server over Streamable HTTP. Set the URL and token, then remove "disabled".
